# Siddhartha Chaturvedi — sidc.ai

## Who
Siddhartha Chaturvedi helps organizations put AI to work, and prove that it works. He leads technical go-to-market for Atlassian's Rovo MCP and is co-founder and partner at StratCorp.AI (https://stratcorp.ai). Former Microsoft Director of Product Management (2016–2025), INSEAD MBA. Fast Company World Changing Ideas Award winner (2021, Microsoft Premonition).

## What He Built
- Microsoft Premonition: robots that catch mosquitoes and test what they carry for disease before outbreaks start
- AI for Health: $60M Microsoft program for 200+ grantees working on child mortality, infectious disease, and health equity
- Generative AI for US federal health agencies (NIH, ARPA-H, CDC, FDA): 300+ use cases went through evaluation gates and 11 passed
- Rovo MCP at Atlassian: technical go-to-market for a platform that has served 1M+ monthly active users, including the Rovo and Google Gemini agent-to-agent integration shown at Google Cloud Next 2026

## Current Focus
AI systems for organizations and health AI validation. He designs everything around the outcome: what drives value, how teams build trust, and where technology plays its part.

## Value Function Framework
A framework for evaluating useful AI across three dimensions:
- Resonance (Voice): aligns outputs to organizational voice so they feel native, not generic
- Relevance (Evidence): grounds responses in verified and proprietary sources to reduce hallucination
- Response (Execution): turns intelligence into deterministic next steps inside the user's workflow
The equilibrium of all three produces AI that ships.

## Three Bets
1. The future of health AI is not prediction. It is evidence. (The Value Function: https://sidc.ai/essays/value-function/)
2. AI's hardest problem now is getting agents, people and systems to work together, not generating more content. (The App That Builds Itself: https://sidc.ai/essays/interface-triage/)
3. Software will have to work equally well for the person clicking and the agent acting on their behalf. (AI Won't Simplify Work: https://sidc.ai/essays/fow/)

## Work With Him
Advisory runs through StratCorp.AI. Talks and workshops come to him directly.
- Enterprise, through StratCorp.AI: working sessions with your leadership team to pick the first agent use cases worth doing, decide where people review the work, and agree how you'll know it's working. For boards, CIOs, product and platform leads.
- Health, through VeriScience: independent evidence that a health AI tool does what it claims. For health AI builders, clinicians, funders.
- Stage: talks and workshops on enterprise agents, AI in health, and how teams review AI output. For conference and offsite organizers.

## Field Notes
- "The Enterprise Refactor" (https://sidc.ai/essays/justai/) — a local field note translating Software 3.0 into context, verification, dual interfaces, and the agent web; links to the full paper at https://justai.fyi
- "The Value Function" (https://sidc.ai/essays/value-function/): a working model + printable worksheet for AI that balances voice, evidence, and execution
- "The App That Builds Itself for One Question" (https://sidc.ai/essays/interface-triage/): what generative UI means \u2014 the model builds a bespoke interface for the question instead of a wall of text \u2014 with an interactive demo
- "AI Won't Simplify Work. It Might Finally Restore It." (https://sidc.ai/essays/fow/) — the real promise of the agentic era isn't speed, it's returning human attention to the complexity that matters

## Doodles
Short, sourced visual stories about public work worth celebrating. Index: https://sidc.ai/doodles/
- "Project Wolbachia at ten" (https://sidc.ai/doodles/wolbachia/): an animated timeline of Singapore's National Environment Agency releasing male Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes since 18 October 2016, from the first field study to the randomised trial and the households reached. Every number is sourced; data at https://sidc.ai/doodles/wolbachia/data.json and data.csv. Independent tribute, not affiliated with NEA.

## Agentic Capabilities (WebMCP)
This site implements the emerging, evolving W3C Web Model Context Protocol (WebMCP) standard to allow AI agents to interact with our strategic frameworks directly.
- **Static Discovery Manifest**: Exposed at `https://sidc.ai/.well-known/webmcp` and `https://sidc.ai/.well-known/webmcp.json`.
- **Dynamic JavaScript WebMCP API**: Loaded dynamically on the client via `https://sidc.ai/js/webmcp.js`.
- **Exposed Tools**:
  - `fetch_professional_profile` — returns Siddhartha's credentials, board advisory roles, and case metrics.
  - `fetch_field_note_summaries` — indexes all active Field Notes with URLs and TL;DR definitions.
  - `triage_workload_interface` — runs the 3x3 workload triage assessment (GUI, Agent, GenUI).
  - `evaluate_system_equilibrium` — runs the Value Function safety/risk checker.
